card.name: Use effective contraception instructions
card.fires_on: The word right after an instruction verb such as use or advise to use, mostly 'effective' before 'alternative or back-up methods of contraception'. It also fires on 'use' or 'of' in phrases like 'use 2 forms of contraception'.
